sources.location: Bjorkum AA et al. PLoS One 2017;12(10):e0185765, PMID 28977037, PMC5627932, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0185765 (open-access full text via Europe PMC)
HTTP range read (first 1 MiB) of FD1_AH_6B_D1.raw, SD1_AH_1_K11.raw and FD9_AH_14B_10.raw from https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2017/10/PXD006349/

claims.evidence: All 20 RAW-category files in the PRIDE file list; every entry's projectAccessions = PXD006349; each file used exactly once. The two .xlsx result files are not runs.

claims.location: source name, factor value[treatment], characteristics[treatment] rows 1-20
claims.value: FD1-FD10 = fast decompression (1 bar/20 s); SD1-SD10 = slow decompression (1 bar/10 min)
claims.evidence: Deposited Progenesis table header groups sample columns FD1-FD10 under 'Fast decompression rate (1 bar/20 s) after heliox saturation (FD)' and SD1-SD10 under 'Slow decompression rate (1 bar/10 min) after heliox saturation diving (SD)'; raw file names carry the same FD#/SD# prefix; paper: FD n=10, SD n=10.
PRIDE organisms NEWT:10116; paper 'female Wistar rats'; NCBITaxon:10116.
'Two groups of female Wistar rats (Charles Rivers Laboratories, USA)'.
'female Wistar rats' (whole cohort).
'From each animal one of the cerebral hemispheres (approximately 0.7 g), excluding both the frontal lobes and the cerebellum'; UBERON:0001869. PRIDE dropdown says brain (BTO:0000142), less specific.
Hemisphere tissue homogenised in HEPES/KCl buffer; supernatant analysed.
Animal number within group from sample labels FD#/SD#; numbering restarts per condition as the spec states. One run per animal.
One hemisphere per animal, analysed per animal (n=10 per group).
Results: DCS symptoms 'were not observed in any rats from the SD group'.
12 of 21 FD rats showed DCS symptoms; per-animal DCS status of the 10 analysed FD rats is not reported.
'One week after the dive the animals were euthanized'.
Age/stage not stated (only weight ~250 g).
Raw headers read 'Orbitrap Velos Pro'; paper 'LTQ-Orbitrap Velos Pro'. PRIDE dropdown 'LTQ Orbitrap Velos' (MS:1001742) is less specific and overridden.
Method: 'ITMS + c norm Dep ... MS/MS Most intense ion', 'Scan Event 2 repeated for top 7 peaks'; paper 'top 7 peaks ... fragmented'.
Method: 'Activation Type: CID'.
Method: 'Normalized Coll. Energy: 35.0'.
MS2 scan event is ITMS (ion trap).
Scan event 1: 'FTMS + p norm o(300.0-2000.0)'.
'Protein samples were trypsinized in solution'; search 'trypsin with one miss-cleavages accepted'.
Label-free Progenesis MS1 quantification; PRIDE quantification method PRIDE:0000425.
'precursor mass tolerance of 10 ppm'.
Paper gives 'fragment mass tolerance of 0.7' without unit; Da inferred because MS2 is ion-trap (ITMS) CID, where 0.7 ppm is not plausible.

claims.location: comment[modification parameters] Carbamidomethyl C Fixed, Oxidation M Variable
claims.evidence: Paper/PRIDE: 'fixed carbamidomethylation on cystein, variable oxidation on methionine'; oxidation of M in deposited peptide table; PRIDE identifiedPTMs MOD:00397/MOD:00425.

claims.location: comment[modification parameters] Acetyl protein N-term, Gln->pyro-Glu, Glu->pyro-Glu, Pyro-carbamidomethyl, Acetyl K (all Variable)
claims.value: UNIMOD:1 PP=Protein N-term; UNIMOD:28 Q N-term; UNIMOD:27 E N-term; UNIMOD:26 C N-term; UNIMOD:1 TA=K
claims.evidence: Deposited Progenesis peptide table 'Modifications' column reports '[1] acetylation of protein n-term' (121), '[1] pyro-glu q' (47), '[1] pyro-glu e' (25), '[1] pyro-cmc' (23), '[1] acetylation of k' (2) alongside oxidation of m; these were therefore in the search space even though the paper lists only C/M mods. No search-parameter file was deposited.

Fixed carbamidomethyl searched (alkylation done), but the in-solution Orbitrap prep reagents are only given 'as previously described'; DTT/IAA in the paper refer to the iontrap gel workflow, which is not in this deposit.
Orbitrap samples were digested in solution and run once each (one raw per animal); the 12-fraction SDS-PAGE workflow applies only to the undeposited iontrap dataset.

limitations: Per-animal DCS symptom status for FD rats is not reported; FD disease is 'not available'.
Fragment tolerance unit (Da) inferred from the ion-trap MS2 analyzer.
No search-parameter file deposited; modifications beyond Carbamidomethyl/Oxidation are inferred from mods reported in the deposited peptide table.
Reduction and alkylation reagents for the in-solution Orbitrap workflow not stated.
The iontrap (Agilent LC/MSD Trap XCT plus, 240 files) dataset described in the paper is not in this deposit and is not annotated.
Raw headers range-read for 3 of 20 files only (FD1, SD1, FD9); FD9 is ~212 MB versus ~830-850 MB for the other runs (cause unknown; it has values in the deposited quant table).
Animal codes in file names (e.g. AH_6B_D1, AH_2_K10) are not decoded; source names use the FD#/SD# labels from the deposited table.
